name: glasser-seo-audit
description: SEO audit of your own website on data from Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO and Serpstat in one place. Give a domain and get technical and on-page health, rankings, keyword opportunities, competitors and keyword gaps, backlinks, search results and AI search visibility, scored and turned into a prioritised action plan: what to fix first and why. Run it again to see what changed.
